description:
Outcome: Coordinator allocates according to household and timely-returner rules (brief.md: Rules; First version must 2).
Scope: Initial allocation opening guard, eligibility, mandatory returner priority, manual assignment, transactional constraints, audited correction/release and recalculation. Excludes: optimisation, guaranteed preferred/previous plot, discretionary priority bypass.
Acceptance: Initial allocations prohibited before Feb 1 00:00 of season year in garden timezone. Active last-season holders who applied before that instant receive available plots before ordinary applicants. Reason or waitlisted status cannot bypass priority; explicit withdrawals audited. Oversubscribed returners use application timestamp/stable ID order. One holder per plot and one plot per household/season even concurrently. Corrections atomic; after finalization route allocations through T-008 FIFO service.
Behaviour: Priority explanations and safe retry; conflicts roll back without partial updates. Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: Test exact deadline, prior vs older history, late returner, attempted January allocation followed by timely returner, reason/waitlist bypass, oversubscription, concurrency and rollback. Prerequisites: T-006. Assumptions: initial allocation begins Feb 1; late returners ordinary pool; within each group application order, stable ID ties.
title: Allocate plots fairly and correct or release allocations
